description: The class map sends a retained ground term to its equivalence class in the carrier, separately from the default point.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.classOf.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (S : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L))
  (E : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.TermPair L)) (hE : E ⊆ S.product S)
  (t : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.GroundTerm L) (ht : t ∈ S) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Carrier S E hE
